claim: 71% of the campaign's 110 raised crate tops begin their tile at the crate's own corner, so the box wears a whole picture whatever the world grid.
evidence: knowledge/blood/findings/probes/audit2_crate_tops.py over the 43 campaign maps: 110 raised crate tops (CRATE_FLOOR_TILES), 78 (71%) land the tile grid on their own corner; 62% expanded, 59% panned, 6% floorstat 64 (bloodmap/texture_frame.py:1236-1239)
use: Anchor the tile grid of a crate's or tomb's top at its own corner by panning (texture_frame.frame_raised_solids); first-wall relative alignment (floorstat 64) is what only 6% of the campaign's crate tops use.

checked.how: Recounted with knowledge/blood/findings/probes/audit2_crate_tops.py (texture_frame.raised_solids on CRATE_FLOOR_TILES, surface_is_whole at sector_corner) over 43 campaign maps: 110 raised crate tops, 78 (71%) whole at their corner, 62% expanded, 59% panned, 6% first-wall relative (texture_frame.py:1236-1239 says the same). build_skeleton.py:2086-2089 calls frame_raised_solids, which anchors by panning at the lowest corner, not floorstat 64.
